title: Trumpet with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bell -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='38' rx='16' ry='20' fill='#FFC94D'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='38' rx='11' ry='14' fill='#FFE9A8'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='38' rx='6' ry='8' fill='#FF9E3D'/>
  <!-- bell rim highlight -->
  <path d='M78 18 a16 20 0 0 1 0 0' fill='none'/>
  <!-- body tube -->
  <rect x='24' y='34' width='52' height='14' rx='7' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <rect x='24' y='36' width='52' height='4' rx='2' fill='#FFE0A0'/>
  <!-- valves -->
  <rect x='36' y='20' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#F28C28'/>
  <rect x='48' y='16' width='7' height='20' rx='3' fill='#F28C28'/>
  <rect x='60' y='20' width='7' height='16' rx='3' fill='#F28C28'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='20' r='4' fill='#FFD98A'/>
  <circle cx='51.5' cy='16' r='4' fill='#FFD98A'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='20' r='4' fill='#FFD98A'/>
  <!-- mouthpiece -->
  <rect x='10' y='36' width='16' height='10' rx='5' fill='#FFE9A8'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='41' r='6' fill='#FFF6D8'/>
  <!-- smiling face on the tube -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='54' r='2.6' fill='#6B3410'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='2.6' fill='#6B3410'/>
  <path d='M33 61 q8.5 8 17 0' fill='none' stroke='#6B3410' stroke-width='2.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='59' r='2.6' fill='#FF8A8A' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='59' r='2.6' fill='#FF8A8A' opacity='0.85'/>
</svg>
